Generate the §2.6.7.7 (Repeat-Dose Toxicity) tabulated summary per ICH M4S(R2). Use the prescribed required columns in order; one row per study.

Source findings:
A 28 days repeat-dose toxicity study was conducted in CD-1 mouse via oral (dietary) at doses of 0, 100, 333, 1000 mg/kg/day. Findings: transient body-weight loss at the high dose. NOAEL was identified as 333 mg/kg/day. A parallel 28 days study in New Zealand white rabbit via oral (dietary) at doses of 0, 3, 10, 30 mg/kg/day showed mild hepatic enzyme elevation at the high dose; NOAEL 10 mg/kg/day.

§2.6.7.7 Repeat-Dose Toxicity — tabulated summary:

| Study | Species | Method of Administration | Duration | Doses (mg/kg/day) | NOAEL (mg/kg/day) | Findings |
|-------|---------|--------------------------|----------|-------------------|-------------------|----------|
| repeat-dose tox (rodent) | CD-1 mouse | oral (dietary) | 28 days | 0, 100, 333, 1000 | 333 | transient body-weight loss at the high dose |
| repeat-dose tox (non-rodent) | New Zealand white rabbit | oral (dietary) | 28 days | 0, 3, 10, 30 | 10 | mild hepatic enzyme elevation at the high dose |
